sections.title: Architecture: Profile Isolation & Portability
sections.content:
Standard VS Code stores settings and extensions in global system directories (%APPDATA%\Code\User and %USERPROFILE%\.vscode\extensions). When working across projects with conflicting plugin requirements or developing from USB drives, global persistence causes configuration drift.

VenvHub Pro introduces a Portable Profile Layer:

  • Complete Isolation: Every profile maintains an independent storage container—custom settings.json, dedicated keybindings, and an isolated extensions directory.
  • Zero Host Footprint: Leaves your host Windows VS Code installation untouched. VenvHub launches the editor with isolated runtime flags (--user-data-dir and --extensions-dir).
  • True USB Portability: Storing profile directories on external drives guarantees an identical developer workspace across any workstation.

sections.title: Configuring Profile Root Storage
sections.content:
Initialize your profile container root:

  1. Open Manager (🖥️) -> Settings tab.
  2. Under 'VS Code Profile', click Account Management.
  3. In Profile Root Directory, click 📁 and choose your storage directory (e.g. vscode_users inside your portable folder).
UUID Hardware Binding: Profile paths bind dynamically to volume UUIDs, ensuring uninterrupted resolution when USB drive letters change.

sections.title: Profile Creation, System Import & Rollback
sections.content:
Creating Isolated Profiles

  • User ID: Filesystem directory name without spaces or special characters (e.g. backend_dev).
  • Display Name: Friendly label visible in workspace dropdowns (e.g. 'Backend - Django Lead').

Importing Host Configuration

To clone your existing Windows VS Code extensions and settings into a clean portable container:

  • On Creation: Check 'Clone from host system during creation'.
  • On Demand: Select an existing profile and click 📥 Import from System Now.
Fail-Safe Rollback Engine: If an import is canceled mid-flight, VenvHub purges partial files automatically, leaving no corrupted dependencies on disk.

sections.title: Active Profiles & 3-Way State Synchronization
sections.content:
1. 3-Way Real-time State Synchronization

Switching an active profile in any UI node updates all nodes simultaneously:

  • Quick Settings: Toolbar dropdown on the Mini-Bar.
  • Master Manager: Primary Profile combobox in Settings.
  • Account Management Matrix: Profile table with ★ [ACTIVE] indicator.

2. Toolbar VS Code Launcher

  • Pre-flight Diagnostic: Verifies workspace existence and Venv health before launching.
  • Profile Injection: Launches VS Code with active user data and extensions paths.
  • Multi-Mode Protection: Hidden in Multi-run mode to prevent multi-root project collisions.
Portability Best Practice: Never modify Python interpreter paths manually inside VS Code settings. Always assign Venvs within VenvHub Pro to preserve automated USB drive letter resolution.
